notes: Documentation is based on uploaded pwe-system 1.0.2 archive.
source_commit is unknown because the archive does not contain trusted repository commit metadata.
Bundled plugin-update-checker code is treated as third-party and excluded from first-party symbol indexing.
Wiki v2 keeps schema_version 1 compatibility and adds entrypoints/load graph/integrations/dependencies/processes inventories.
Traits are stored under php-symbols classes for importer compatibility and marked with kind=trait.
Trait composition is mapped in inventory/trait-uses.json so runtime class callbacks can be resolved to trait definitions.
Version metadata mismatch is preserved in issues.json rather than silently reconciled.
